candidates.title: Test compact search results against iterative match browsing
candidates.rule: For repository-repair agents, compare a compact search interface with interfaces that require opening matches one at a time; measure tool-call and context overhead as well as fix rate.
candidates.passage: agents tend to look through every match exhaustively
candidates.finding: Iterative search reaches 12.0% resolved versus 15.7% without extra search tools and 18.0% for the complete interface in the reported ablation. Exhaustive browsing can consume the task budget.
models: GPT-4 family; Section 5.1 describes the GPT-4 configuration
candidates.conditions: Custom agent-computer interface with bounded search output, file viewer and editor. The inspected excerpt describes the interface ablation, not a universal search algorithm comparison.
candidates.limitations: The result concerns an older model and particular interfaces. Search quality, limits and context presentation interact; fewer tool calls alone do not imply better repairs.
candidates.validation_test: Compare result summaries, iterative browsing and the existing interface at matched task budgets; evaluate repair success, search omissions, tokens and calls.

candidates.title: Reject syntax-breaking edits with immediate feedback
candidates.rule: For repository repair, test an editor that checks proposed modifications for major syntax errors before applying them and returns actionable feedback when rejecting an edit.
candidates.passage: This intervention improves performance considerably (without linting, 15.0 % ↓ 3.0 ).
candidates.finding: Removing edit-time linting reduces resolved tasks from 18.0% to 15.0% in the ablation. The guard is intended to prevent cascading edits after an introduced syntax error.
models: GPT-4 family; Section 5.1 describes the GPT-4 configuration
candidates.conditions: Agent uses a multi-line editor with automatic view updates and major-error checks.
candidates.limitations: Syntax acceptance does not establish semantic correctness. Existing malformed files and multi-step transformations may require different policies; blocking intermediate states can interfere with legitimate edits.
candidates.validation_test: Compare guarded and unguarded editing on held-out issues, recording resolved tasks, failed-edit cascades and false rejections; still run functional validation.

review_scope: Selected abstract, introduction, methods or main-result sections; not a comprehensive paper or appendix review.
